analysis.name: q59 paired cumulative-PPL chunk reconstruction
analysis.rounding_aggregate_effects: Rounding errors telescope out of mean(d); under the uniform model the RMS d_k noise is 1.6e-4..2.7e-4 and SE/CI-width inflation is <= 0.05%
analysis.rounding_assumption: P_k printed to 4 decimals; abs error in ln(P_k) <= 0.00005/P_k
analysis.rounding_nll_bound_approximation: (2*k-1)*0.00005/P_k is an upper bound only when P_(k-1) >= P_k; exact adjacent-term bound is k*h/P_k + (k-1)*h/P_(k-1)
analysis.sign_test: two-sided exact binomial sign test with zero d values dropped
